meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 剪辑出品牌片、蒙太奇、片头等各类自定义视频作品。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要灵活创作非模板化的自定义视频内容。
copy.tagline_en: Produce and edit custom video pieces, from brand reels to montages.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a flexible video creation tool for original, non-templated content.

howto.what: 它按 HyperFrames 流程帮你创作或修改视频项目：先核对技能版本与项目状态，再规划场景、调用所需素材与动画规范，产出计划文档和分镜结构并构建画面；多场景会逐场列出，经你确认才进入渲染。
howto.when: 当你要新做或编辑较长/多场景视频（如品牌宣传片、混剪、蒙太奇等），且没有更专门的技能可用，或项目的 BRIEF.md 设为 flow: companion 时接管。新创作会先由 hyperframes 主流程分派，再进入本技能。

say.text: 帮我做一支30秒的品牌宣传片，包含产品开场、使用场景和结尾放品牌标识。
say.note: 它会先检查项目状态并规划场景，再开始制作。

say.text: 把现在这个视频的第2场和第4场对调，再加一个缩放过渡。
say.note: 它只做这一处修改，保留项目其他决定。

say.text: 用“夏日新品”这四个字做一个6秒的静态标题卡。
say.note: 它先给出版式方案，你同意后再制作。

howto.what_en: Creates or edits HyperFrames video projects. It checks skill/project state, plans scenes, loads media/animation specs, drafts stories/scenes, then builds them. Multi-scene work is listed per scene and only renders after approval.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you request or edit a long/multi-scene video (e.g. brand reel, montage, remix) with no more specific skill, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Fresh work first routes through the hyperframes pipeline.

say_en.text: Make me a 30-second brand reel: product opener, usage scene, and ending brand mark.
say_en.note: It checks project state and plans scenes before building.

say_en.text: Swap scene 2 and scene 4 in the current video, then add a zoom transition.
say_en.note: It makes just this change; other project decisions stay.

say_en.text: Make a 6-second static title card for the words “Summer New Arrivals”.
say_en.note: It proposes a design, then builds after your OK.
